newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Chung Hwa corrects bonus issue figures.
newsitem.headline: Chung Hwa corrects bonus issue figures.

text.p: Chung Hwa Development Holdings Ltd said it had understated in a circular to shareholders dated September 11 the number of its existing shares and bonus shares to be issued in a four-for-five bonus share issue proposal.
The circular stated that 435.45 million new shares would be issued and alloted on the basis of a total of 544.31 million existing shares, the company said.
But Chung Hwa said it overlooked 1.875 million shares issued under the company's shares option scheme in July 1996 and 6,250 shares issued upon the exercise of certain subscription rights.
The correct number of the existing shares as of September 27 should be 546.19 million shares and the total number of bonus shares 436.95 million, it said.
Trading in Chung Hwa shares resumed on Tuesday after Monday's suspension. They closed the morning session down one cent at HK$1.38.
